question.worked_solution:
Notice that the leading coefficient is negative. To reduce the expression to a more familiar form, we can factor out $-1,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}-4{m}^{2}-4m-1 & = \\ -(4{m}^{2}+4m+1)\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we factor the quadratic expression inside the parentheses using the square of a sum formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}4{m}^{2}+4m+1 & = \\ (2m)^{2}+4m+{1}^{2} & = \\ (2m)^{2}+2\cdot (2m\cdot 1)+{1}^{2} & = \\ (2m+1)^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, our original expression factors as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}-(4{m}^{2}+4m+1) & = \\ -(2m+1)^{2} & \end{aligned}
$$
